headline: Coastal Outposts Contested as Fishermans Row and Farranac Flare
war_summary: Fishermans Row has seen an immediate spike in combat over the past two hours, logging four rapid base exchanges across Fort Ember, Hangman's Court, and Arcadia. Farranac Coast maintains a blistering pace of fighting, clocking three additional base transitions around Scythe and Terra within the same window. Meanwhile, fighting on Tempest Island, Lykos Isle, and Godcrofts has begun to settle following heavy afternoon turnover, recording no further strategic changes in the last two hours. On the eastern front, Stlican Shelf registered fresh base contest around Fort Hoarfrost amid heavy casualty rates. Across the mainland interior, the bitter war of attrition grinds relentlessly onward: Dead Lands, Weathered Expanse, Marban Hollow, and King's Cage continue to absorb thousands of casualties every hour, yet defensive positions remain firmly locked with no strategic territorial shifts.
